payload.core_composition_summary: Sort items by a_i-b_i ascending; buy first k now, for rest switch to later if now>later to minimize cost.
payload.rationale: The algorithm sorts by cost difference and greedily decides which items to purchase now vs later based on sorted order. This is a classic sorting+greedy approach.
